alert_conditions.toxic_gas: Immediate attention required to protect plants and ensure safety.

alert_conditions.low: Soil moisture below 20% may cause irreversible damage. Please inspect and irrigate immediately.
alert_conditions.high: Soil moisture above 80% deprives roots of oxygen, can lead to rot and disease. Please take corrective action.

alert_conditions.low: Soil pH below 6.5 may cause irreversible damage. Please test and amend the soil to raise pH.
alert_conditions.high: Soil pH above 7.5 hinders nutrient and water uptake. Please test and adjust the soil pH accordingly.

alert_conditions.note: No alerts are issued based on light conditions.

alert_conditions.low: Air temperature below 18°C can stress plants. Please monitor and take protective measures.
alert_conditions.high: Air temperature above 28°C can stress plants. Please monitor and take protective measures.

alert_conditions.low: Air humidity below 40% may affect plant health. Please assess and adjust environmental conditions.
alert_conditions.high: Air humidity above 80% may affect plant health. Please assess and adjust environmental conditions.
